decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development shall be constructed in strict accordance with the drawings hereby approved or drawings which are subsequently approved pursuant to conditions which are attached to this planning permission.

Condition : 2 - The cycle parking shown on drawing no. 690/30C shall be
    so provided and maintained permanently throughout the
    duration of the use.

Condition : 3 - No meter boxes, flues, vents or pipes shall be fixed or installed on the [external face][street elevations] of the building.

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies EN1 and EN13 [and EN31 if in a CA] of the London Borough of Camden Unitary Development Plan 2000.

Condition : 4 - The facing materials to be used on the ................. shall not be otherwise than as shall have been submitted to and approved by the Council before any work on the site is commenced.

Condition : 5 - The facing/roofing systems to be used on the exterior of the
    building shall be:- Eternit `Rivendale'; Ashpark Yellow
    Brick by Cranleigh Facing Brick; Lockroll stucco finish, p/
    mill thermocore by Rigdal unless the Council agrees to
    alternative materials in writing.G

Condition : 6 - All glazing on the Grys Inn Road elevation of the property
    shall be clear glazed.

Condition : 7 - To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the
    character of the immediate area.

Condition : 8 - Because it is considered that these would seriously detract
    from the appearance of the building.

Condition : 9 - To ensure that the Council may be satisfied with the
    external appearance of the building.

Condition : 10 - The development hereby approved must be carried out in
    strict compliance with the plans referred to in this
    permission. Any alteration to the approved scheme resulting
    either from the requirements of the Building Control
    Manager, or for any other cause, must not take place except
    with the written agreement of the Council as local planning
    authority.

Condition : 11 - The Building Regulations may impose requirements for sound
    insulation between dwellings, and you are advised to consult
    Building Control Service, located at Camden Town Hall
    Argyle Street, WC1H 8EQ. (Tel: 0171 413 6941)

Condition : 12 - The Council's Streets Management Engineering Services should
    be consulted regarding the construction of the crossover on
    the public highway and any other work to, under, or over,
    the public highway, including vaults and thresholds. The
    Section dealing with these matters is located at Camden Town
    Hall, Argyle Street London WC1H 8EQ, (tel: 071-278 4444).

Condition : 13 - This decision is without prejudice to the Council's position
    as owner of the adjoining property, nor of any interest it
    may have in the property. Moreover, this decision is without
    prejudice to the rights of tenants in the adjoining
    properties.

Condition : 14 - To ensure the permanent provision of cycle parking in the
    interest of ameliorating any potential congestion which may
    result from the uses.

Condition : 15 - In order that the Council may be satisfied with the external
    appearance of the building and to maintain the appearance of
    the area generally.

Condition : 16 - In order that the Council may be satisfied with the
    external appearance of the building.

Condition : 17 - Your attention is drawn to the fact that there is a separate
    legal agreement with the Council which relates to the
    development for which this permission is granted.
